simulation: CPU PhysX, existing 0.01 s simulation step / 0.05 s control step
trigger: first three consecutive post-step is_grasped=true reports; at least 8 steps must remain
intervention_timing: after selecting the next normal command, immediately before its first physics substep
disturbance: one native add_force_at_point(mode=impulse) at world-frame cube COM; vector [J,0,0] N s
prefix: identical through the grasp-trigger frame and through the next pre-impulse command/policy/RNG snapshot
observations: no extra sensor refresh or inference; first post-impulse observation is returned after the intervened control step and enters policy on the following call
validity_gate: free-body momentum increment J/m, zero COM torque, one-shot application, no pose change at API call; stop on failure
sham_gate: compare full 200-step traces, state/controller fields, policy history/queue and RNG; stop on divergence
pilot_order: all clean/sham pairs first; then all predeclared severities on all six seeds, ascending severity
selection: eligible if final success is neither 0/6 nor 6/6 and includes a paired regression and a preserved success; closest to 3/6, then smallest impulse
refinement: If no coarse level is eligible and adjacent levels bracket 6/6 and 0/6, evaluate exactly one geometric midpoint on all six seeds; otherwise stop inconclusive. No seed exclusion.
repeat: repeat all three branches of the selected configuration on all six identical seeds; compare full traces and stop at the first mismatch
videos: after repeat verification, render all three branches for the first seed, first paired regression and first preserved success (deduplicated); verify rendered traces against stored traces
regrasp_latency: first lost-grasp frame after the event to the first of three consecutive grasped frames; null if no loss, right-censored if never regained
goal_latency: event to first of five consecutive success frames; completion proxy if the task was not yet successful at the event; compare with paired clean
uncertainty: Wilson 95% intervals on six unique seeds, paired regression/improvement counts; repeats do not increase n. Severity selected on the same exploratory pilot, no confirmatory inference.
pass: physical validity, all prefix/sham checks, eligible nontrivial severity, and deterministic repeats pass
limits: one state-only policy/task, fixed direction, idealized uncalibrated impact, one timestep; no repair, learned weights changes, novelty, sim-to-real or general robustness claim
rendering: CPU renderer in every branch and repetition; optional frame reads never enter policy
